description: A weapon key pressed during the fire cooldown is remembered, and the switch starts only when the cooldown ends (Quake 3's rule), so switching can't skip a weapon's recovery.

expect.note: Tick 21: the pistol fired on tick 1 and its 21-tick cooldown is still running, so the shotgun key (pressed on ticks 4 to 6) is waiting.
Tick 33: lowering started on tick 22 when the cooldown ended, and takes 12 ticks, so the shotgun is in hand from tick 34. The switch can't cut the pistol's recovery short.
